# VJ Model Library licenses

The model files in this directory are intentionally kept small and are redistributed under the following licenses.

## Kenney Nature Kit

- Files: `KenneyNature/flower_redA.*`, `KenneyNature/plant_flatShort.*`
- Creator: Kenney (https://kenney.nl)
- Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/nature-kit
- License: Creative Commons Zero 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0)
- The original `License.txt` is included next to the models.

These original low-poly files are retained for reference, but the default `sprout` and `flower`
library entries now use the Poly Haven models below.

## Poly Haven botanical models

- Files: `StandardPoly/anthurium_botany_01_1k.fbx`, `StandardPoly/periwinkle_plant_1k.fbx`
- Titles: Anthurium Botany 01, Periwinkle Plant
- Authors: Rico Cilliers and Rob Tuytel (Anthurium); Amal Kumar (Periwinkle)
- Sources: https://polyhaven.com/a/anthurium_botany_01 and https://polyhaven.com/a/periwinkle_plant
- License: Creative Commons Zero 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0)

## Animated Human

- File: `QuaterniusHuman/Animated Human.fbx`
- Creator: Quaternius (https://quaternius.com)
- Source: https://opengameart.org/content/animated-human-low-poly
- License: Creative Commons Zero 1.0 Universal (CC0 1.0)
- The original `License.txt` is included next to the model.

The default `walking-person` entry uses `StandardPoly/Smooth_Male_Casual.fbx` from the
Quaternius Animated Men Pack, also released under CC0 1.0.
